reference.name: Browser Back retains the newer profile repository search draft while restoring earlier results
reference.summary: After searching for repository A then B and going Back, the URL and results restore A while the search box retains the last typed B draft.
reference.expected: The report expects the visible search text to restore A together with its results.
reference.actual: The browser restores the last typed field value B, while the response input value attribute, URL and repository results correctly restore A. Normal submissions, Forward and navigation without editing the field are consistent.
reproSteps: On a user profile Repositories tab, search for a uniquely named repository A and confirm its matching result.
Search for a different uniquely named repository B and confirm its matching result.
Press browser Back and compare the URL, visible query field and results.
Observe A in the URL and results while B remains in the search field.
reference.reason: User rejected the reported draft-only display mismatch, consistent with gitea-pass2-007. Both reviewers reproduced the mismatch but disagreed on classification: Claude rejected it as browser-restored draft state, while Codex recommended acceptance at severity 1. This rejection is the explicit human judgment; it does not claim the observation failed to reproduce. A later Sort action applying the visible draft was observed separately and is excluded from this rejection, as are hidden filters or incorrect server search results.
